hero.desc: HexaBlue is an organization dedicated to the development of open source software in a variety of categories.

about.title: About HexaBlue
about.desc:
HexaBlue is an organization founded by Flamey with the goal of providing quality free and open source software solutions to any problem.
Flamey is the only member at the moment, but we are always looking for more volunteers.

project_overview.title: Main Projects
project_overview.dibsy:
dibsy is an all-in-one, peer-to-peer social network platform.
A never-seen-before concept in which there is no such thing as a server: all the content is shared between users.
It grants privacy and customization as freely as an open platform would.
project_overview.seggs:
Server Eggs is a Discord bot based on user-generated content, designed as a fun way to spread servers and funny media around.
It also has various other fun features, but the only way to know is to try it...!
